description: Luw.ai Sketch AI: turn a hand sketch, line drawing, floor-plan perspective or rough draft into a photorealistic render. Costs 1 credit per variation.

engine.description: Luw.ai model: symphony (Symphony-3, the default: the higher quality) or aria (quicker, for everyday work). If the user picked a model earlier in this conversation, use that one.

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

image.description: The sketch or drawing (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

persona_id.description: Persona whose saved images to use. Its saved styles and room or building type apply unless you send styles or a type.

precision.description: How freely the prompt enhancer writes: 90 = precise, 75 = balanced, 40 = creative. Only used with enhance_prompt.

prompt.description: What you want, in plain language.

space_type.description: What the sketch shows, e.g. "Living Room" or "Modern House Exterior".

style_reference.description: Style-transfer source: an image whose look to copy (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path), or "persona" to use slot 1 of persona_id.

styles.description: Design style names, e.g. ["Scandinavian"]; for Japandi use ["Japanese Design", "Scandinavian"]. Case-sensitive; see luw_list_options.

variations.description: Number of alternative designs (1-4, default 1); each is billed as a generation.

name: luw_sketch_to_render
title: Sketch to render (Sketch AI)
